main.description: Quest system state for cross-device sync (dismissals, nudge timing, visited routes). Singleton record (rkey: self), overwritten via putRecord. Client-written (no backend signing). Distinct from net.anisota.chronicle.fieldwork (immutable, backend-signed completion records).

counters.description: Reserved for future quest progress counters. Object mapping counter ids to values.

dismissed.description: Object mapping dismissed quest ids to the ISO datetime they were dismissed. Dismissed quests are excluded from recommendations and nudges until undismissed.

lastNudgeAt.description: When a quest nudge was last shown (nudges are spaced at least a day apart)

lastNudgeQuestId.description: Which quest the most recent nudge was about

pinnedQuestId.description: Quest the player has pinned to keep in view

retroSweepAt.description: When the retroactive completion sweep last ran (throttles the sweep to once per day)

retroSweepVersion.description: Version of the retroactive sweep that armed retroSweepAt. When it doesn't match the client's current sweep version the throttle is treated as stale and the sweep runs once more, so a throttle armed by an earlier (buggy) sweep can't lock out backfill.

snoozedUntil.description: Suppress quest nudges until this time

updatedAt.description: When this state snapshot was taken

visitedRoutes.description: Object mapping visited app routes (e.g. '/chronicle') to the ISO datetime of the first tracked visit. Drives route-based quest detection.
